decision_clause: Ruled out: "a separate evidence-kind allowlist" — because "a literal detached from the producer methods can silently accept evidence no collector emits". Scope: gitseed/category.py, tests/test_category.py; lifecycle active.
label: COMPLIANT
observable_behavior: The set of evidence kinds a category pack may name is still computed by iterating the producer callables (`_files`, `_manifest_entries`, `_dependencies`, `_source`) and stripping the leading underscore from each `__name__` (gitseed/category.py:42-48, 105-106). `satisfiable_evidence()` returns exactly that computed set (line 231-232) and `validate_pack()` rejects any requirement whose evidence name is not in it (line 303-312), so an evidence kind no producer emits cannot be accepted. `absent_evidence()` likewise enumerates from the same derived set. No literal list of evidence names was introduced anywhere in the module. The one new module-level frozenset, `MANIFEST_FILENAMES` (lines 16-18), enumerates manifest *file names* (`package.json`, `pyproject.toml`, `Cargo.toml`, `go.mod`, `requirements.txt`) and only decides which fetched files get parsed; the identical set literal already existed inline in the removed `_manifest()` helper, so it was hoisted, not added. The other set literal, `{"dependencies", "requires"}` in `_toml_entries` (line 158), gates which TOML table/key is treated as a dependency list — it is a manifest-parsing heuristic, not a vocabulary of evidence kinds, and it does not feed `evidence_names` or `validate_pack`. The remaining work is per-format entry-name extraction (JSON key recursion, TOML table/key/quoted-value scanning, go.mod require blocks, requirements lines) plus `-_.`→`-` normalization, with the `mcp` / `ollama` value literals staying inside their own producer methods.
rationale: The recorded decision forbids one specific structure: a standalone literal enumerating evidence kinds, sitting apart from the producer methods, that `validate_pack`/`satisfiable_evidence` would consult instead of the producers. The final tree keeps the producer-derived path fully intact — `evidence_names` is still a comprehension over `self._producers`, and the guard test `test_satisfiable_evidence_is_derived_from_reader_output` (tests/test_category.py:90-100) still asserts the three-way equality between `satisfiable_evidence(reader)`, the evidence names actually produced by `read_evidence`, and the producer method names; it is untouched by the diff and passes (19 passed in tests/test_category.py). The change is confined to how manifest text is parsed into entry names before a producer decides whether to emit `mcp` or `ollama`; nothing about which evidence kinds exist moved into a literal. `MANIFEST_FILENAMES` is the closest thing to a new allowlist, but it lists manifest filenames rather than evidence kinds, it pre-existed inline in the code the diff replaced, and it cannot cause `validate_pack` to accept evidence no collector emits — the failure mode the decision names. Reading the decision's "evidence-kind" to cover a filename filter would be stretching it into a rule about parser inputs that the recorded reason does not support, so this is not a borderline case: the ruled-out structure is absent and the invariant it protected is still enforced in code and in test.
